2019 Q1.gq: Given our record first quarter results and outlook, we are raising our full-year earnings guidance.
2019 Q1.bq: I am very pleased to report record first quarter 2019 financial results, which exceeded the earnings guidance provided and represents the ninth consecutive quarter with year-over-year growth in both value-added sales and operating profit.

2021 Q1.gq: Looking first at the second quarter, we expect adjusted earnings per share in the range of $0.72 to $0.76 per share, which is up about 68% from last year at the midpoint.

2021 Q2.gq: With the ongoing strength of our organic pipeline and good underlying demand across our end markets, we're increasing our outlook for the remainder of the year.

2022 Q1.bq: Q1 also marked our first full quarter of HCS-Electronic Materials results, which exceeded our expectations.
